## Technology

Name, and a link to its official docs.

## Where it belongs

Proposed path — `skills/{category}/{technology}/`. Run `ls skills` to pick an existing category; say so
explicitly if you think none fits.

## Why it's worth covering

Who would use it, and what an agent gets wrong today without it.

## Scope

- [ ] `SKILL.md` only
- [ ] `SKILL.md` + `quick-ref/` guides (list the filenames you'd add)

## I'd like to write this

- [ ] Yes — assign it to me
- [ ] No — just proposing it
